text: {"status":"unresolved","evidence_ids":["ev-99f1fabd46f755abf1eb6822","ev-246ad8fa7079eb079e821daa","ev-132d01d4afe1a2815efd3eca","ev-ed0163014611760a47c8ab9e"],"request_dft":true,"proposed_test_ids":["relax-valid-pristine-and-vacancy-cells-same-signature","rebuild-and-relax-puckered-phosphorene-from-reference-structure"],"rationale":"No peers have spoken, so this is my own assessment. I computed the vacancy formation energy E_f = E(P35) − (35/36)·E(P36), or equivalently E(P35) − 35·E_atom(pristine), from the archived PBE numbers. The result depends entirely on which pristine reference is used, and neither reference gives a physical value. (1) Pairing the vacancy cell (ev-132d…, −174.142 eV) with the 3x3 pristine cell (ev-ed01…, −141.360 eV, −3.927 eV/atom) gives about −36.7 eV, which is nonsense. A pristine 3x3 cell should be near 9 × (−19.777) ≈ −178 eV, so the P36 record is about 37 eV off and cannot be a valid reference. (2) Pairing the vacancy cell with the P4 unit-cell energy per atom (ev-99f1…, −4.944 eV/atom) gives about −1.10 eV. That is negative and unphysical, because a vacancy should cost energy, and it is not a clean comparison since the k-meshes differ (8x11x1 vs 3x4x1). A result below 2 eV on this basis would be an artifact, not support for the claim. (3) The geometry record (ev-246a…) also raises doubts about whether the pristine structure is puckered phosphorene. It shows only 1 neighbor within 2.5 Å per atom and a second-neighbor distance of 2.745 Å, where puckered phosphorene should have 3 neighbors near 2.2 Å. The record also shows only 1 ionic step, so the pristine reference is probably not a correctly built or relaxed phosphorene sheet. The pristine and vacancy cells are inconsistent with each other (energy per atom −3.93 vs −4.98 eV/atom for the same nominal structure). The scope is also unspecified. The evidence therefore neither supports nor contradicts the threshold of 2 eV. A DFT rerun could decide it: rebuild and relax the puckered phosphorene from the reference structure, then relax matched pristine and vacancy 3x3 cells with the same method signature and k-mesh. I would challenge any peer who reports a value from these records as decisive, since each possible pairing is either inconsistent or unphysical."}
